SYNTHETIC SAMPLE: NOT FOR SUBMISSION

We request review of this dispute under the merchant-selected challenge-all policy. The following records and limitations are supplied without predicting the outcome.

Case intake identifies order "ATM-1043", disputed amount $75.00, and reason "product_not_received". These are case-intake values, not independently verified findings.

Code supplies factual wording, citations and assessment. The model arranges the inventory only.

NO VERIFIED AFFIRMATIVE SUPPORT SELECTED
This case requires manual evidence review before a substantive challenge can be prepared. Payment or issuance alone does not establish receipt. No winning argument is invented.

Review the original records and the separate internal evidence inventory before approval. Necessary qualifications are retained with each selected statement. Approval and submission remain separate actions.
